t: You're looking at numbers ten to seventeen, Walton Place, in Kensington and Chelsea. The terrace was designed by George Basevi, who lived from 1794 to 1845. He was a pupil of Sir John Soane and worked in both Neoclassical and Gothic Revival styles. His designs included Belgrave Square in London and the Fitzwilliam Museum in Cambridge. He was also surveyor to the Thurloe estate, so this is work by an architect with wide experience.
